sources.name: Forsyth County Old U.S. 421 River Park facilities page
observations: The County lists a concrete ramp for river access at the park, along with a 44-space parking lot.
The same official park record gives the street address 7695 Old Yadkinville Road.
sources.limits: Confirms the public ramp and parking, but the page does not publish a ramp coordinate.

sources.name: North Carolina Wildlife Resources Commission fishing access report
observations: Lists Old Us Hwy 421 Park on the Yadkin River at 36.1323,-80.4439, exactly matching the shared route coordinate.
Classifies the location as bank access and canoe access.
sources.limits: The agency coordinate identifies a public canoe/bank access locality; it does not label or georeference the ramp toe.

sources.name: Forsyth County Old U.S. 421 River Park history page
observations: Documents the park as part of the County Parks System and says the County acquired it to provide permanent public access to the Yadkin River.
sources.limits: Supports public access identity, not the precise route coordinate.

sources.name: Google Maps satellite imagery at the stored point
observations: The point falls in the park approach/parking area near the county road, with the river edge obscured by vegetation and outside the pin location.
The image supports a site anchor, not a precise replacement ramp coordinate.
sources.limits: Visual context only; no coordinate was derived from the screenshot.

decision: Retain the exact North Carolina Wildlife Resources Commission canoe-access coordinate as a public access-site anchor; keep the river-entry toe unresolved.
